_comment: Cell descriptor for layout/bin/compose-cell.py -- see layout/README.md for the recipe and
layout/temp_core/README.md for this cell's floorplan, routing, results and limits.
Issue #104 (T1 item 2, a leaf cell; item 2 stays unmet until temp_por_top exists).
Whole .subckt temp_core of design/netlist/temp_core.spice: 48 devices, none excluded.
Two stages. 'xq1' draws XQ1 (one bjt_array unit, closed collector ring, base tied to
the ring inside the stage). The final stage places it, the reused
body-tie islands, five res_array resistors and one cap_array MiM cap.
Routing: VDD/VSS are met1 rails. Every other device net is a two-layer channel route:
a met1 vertical from each pin to a junction block (jct_m1.gds, one 0.32um met1 pad
with four co-located ports) on the net's own met2 track, and met2 between junctions.
The j_* blocks exist only because a gen-compose leg cannot change plane at a waypoint
